descFull: Open-source, single-binary, self-hosted AI agent — your models and data stay on your machine. A coding agent on par with Claude Code and a personal assistant lighter than OpenClaw, across eight interfaces (TUI, CLI, Web, desktop, IM, VS Code, Obsidian, Mobile), all in one MIT-licensed Go binary running on any model.
